purpose: Form INC-30 is used to apply to the Regional Director for the conversion of a public company into a private company under section 14.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Within sixty days from the date of passing of special resolution
steps: Pass a special resolution to authorize the alteration for conversion.
Prepare e-Form No. RD-1 with the required particulars set out in the rules.
Attach the required documents including the e-Memorandum, e-Articles, minutes, and declarations.
File the application with the Regional Director within sixty days of passing the special resolution along with the prescribed fee.
checklist: e-Memorandum of Association and e-Articles of Association with proposed alterations
Copy of the minutes of the general meeting with vote details and names of dissenters
Copy of Board resolution or Power of Attorney dated not earlier than thirty days authorising the filing
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding member limit and no deposit violations
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding compliance with sections 73 to 76A, 177, 178, 185, 186, and 188
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding pending resolutions under section 179(3) and stock exchange delisting compliance
Particulars of the date of the Board meeting and general meeting
Particulars of reasons for conversion and effect on stakeholders
Details of any conversion made within the last five years and outcome along with a copy of the order
attachments: e-Memorandum of Association and e-Articles of Association with proposed alterations
Copy of the minutes of the general meeting at which the special resolution was passed with vote details and dissenters
Copy of Board resolution or Power of Attorney dated not earlier than thirty days authorising to file application
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding member limit and deposits
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding non-compliance of specified sections
Declaration by a key managerial personnel or director regarding pending resolutions and delisting
watch: The application must be filed within sixty days from the date of passing of the special resolution.
